pipes.name: filter-json
pipes.description: Selects Flux records by type (`--type` / `--not-type`, exact match) or by naming a field to look in, and projects the fields you want (the required envelope always stays). Not a grep stand-in: whole-record search was removed in 2026-09 because it duplicated `grep -i` and rewrote the bytes.
pipes.author: takakix2

pipes.name: flux
pipes.description: Package manager for the flux family. Fetches pipes and the declarations that turn them into dot-verbs.
pipes.author: takakix2

pipes.name: flux-du
pipes.description: Where the space under the current directory goes, as Flux signals: one record per directory with the totals under it (size, disk blocks, files, dirs), sorted by path. The tree is walked in parallel. Sorting by size, the top few or one depth are the next command's job. Takes no path: cd there first. Linux, macOS and Windows.
pipes.author: takakix2

pipes.name: flux-env
pipes.description: The environment this process got, as Flux signals: one record per variable (name, value, list, origin, redacted, hidden), by name. List-like variables (PATH, PYTHONPATH, XDG_DATA_DIRS, ...) come split on the OS's separator. Values of variables whose names say they are secrets are hidden unless --reveal. With names, only those (exit 1 when none is set). Linux, macOS and Windows.
pipes.author: takakix2

pipes.name: flux-eye
pipes.description: High-speed filesystem scanner. Streams directory structure as Flux NDJSON.
pipes.author: takakix2

pipes.name: flux-find
pipes.description: Fuzzy filename finder. Streams matches as Flux NDJSON.

pipes.name: flux-grep
pipes.description: Fast signal extraction from NDJSON streams. Filter and search structured data at speed.
pipes.author: takakix2

pipes.name: flux-id
pipes.description: Who this process runs as, as Flux signals: one identity record (user, uid/gid or SID, primary group, home, shell, privileged), then one record per group. What id, whoami and groups say on Unix and whoami /user /groups says on Windows, in one shape. Linux, macOS and Windows.
pipes.author: takakix2

pipes.name: flux-ls
pipes.description: What is in the current directory, as Flux signals: one record per entry (path, name, kind, size, mtime, hidden, link target, mode, owner, ...), sorted by name. Nothing is hidden or reordered here -- dotfiles come out with hidden: true, and sorting, filtering and tables are the next command's job. Takes no path: cd there first. Linux, macOS and Windows.
pipes.author: takakix2

pipes.name: flux-priority
pipes.description: Relevance ranker. Orders files by git activity -- each commit that touched a file adds 0.5 ** (age / 7 days), uncommitted and out-of-git files count their modified time once -- and emits them in priority order as Flux NDJSON.

pipes.name: flux-proc
pipes.description: What the system is doing right now, as Flux signals: host, load, memory, CPU, disks, network interfaces and processes, one snapshot per run, each kind as its own `type` (keep what you want with `filter-json --type`). Linux, macOS and Windows.
pipes.author: takakix2

pipes.name: flux-read
pipes.description: Token-budgeted file reader. Streams file contents as Flux NDJSON.

pipes.name: flux-render
pipes.description: Universal format converter. Renders Flux NDJSON as JSON, Markdown, CSV or YAML (and back) -- the interchange layer with the outside world.
pipes.author: takakix2

pipes.name: flux-wc
pipes.description: Lines, words, bytes and characters, as Flux signals: one record per file (lines, words, bytes, chars, max_line, utf8), in input order. Counts the files named, the files Flux records on stdin point to (flux-ls | flux-wc), or the text on stdin itself. Files are read in parallel. Linux, macOS and Windows.
pipes.author: takakix2

pipes.name: flux-write
pipes.description: File writer for the Flux series. Overwrite, append, replace a line range, move or mkdir from one command.

pipes.name: json-to-table
pipes.description: Renders an NDJSON stream as a formatted ASCII table, collecting columns from the keys it sees. Human-readable end of a pipeline.
pipes.author: takakix2
